title.value: Handling Delay in Real-Time Reinforcement Learning
title.justification: The title is clearly stated at the top of the provided paper text, and it reflects the core content discussed throughout the document, thus justifying its selection as the paper title.
title.quote: H ANDLING D ELAY IN R EAL -T IME R EINFORCEMENT L EARNING

analysis.description: This paper addresses the challenges of real-time reinforcement learning, particularly focusing on the delay caused by the neural network's computation time. It proposes a solution that uses temporal skip connections and history-augmented observations to tackle observational delays and improve performance across various environments. The effectiveness of these methods is evaluated through experiments, demonstrating significant improvements in inference speed and policy performance.

type.justification: The paper involves experimental evaluations of different models and architectures in various environments, such as Mujoco and MinAtar, to assess performance improvements from the proposed solutions.
type.quote: We perform our main experiments on Mujoco (Todorov et al., 2012), MiniAtar (Young & Tian, 2019) and MiniGrid (Chevalier-Boisvert et al., 2023) environments.

name.justification: The paper focuses on challenges and solutions specifically related to reinforcement learning in real-time environments.
name.quote: Real-time reinforcement learning (RL) introduces several challenges. First, policies are constrained to a fixed number of actions per second due to hardware limitations.
